messages:
dante_sales: Marco on the PoC call just hit a mix of 401 and 403 when calling generate + embeddings. Customer also sent a security questionnaire asking about key rotation and KMS. Can infra + SE help triage quickly?

marco_acme: I'm intermittently getting `401 Unauthorized` then `403 Forbidden: project claim does not match request` on the same CI job. We rotated the key via the portal 10m ago. Using header X-Redwood-Project: acme-poc and the new key.

frida_infra: thanks Marco. Two quick checks: 1) was the old key cached anywhere in your CI runners? 2) can you paste the sanitized curl you're running?

marco_acme: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk.live.NEWKEY" -H "X-Redwood-Project: acme-poc" -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","input":"hi"}'

zoe_se: also you mentioned embeddings failing 14 which call is that? endpoint /v1/embeddings? any error payload?

marco_acme: embeddings call returns `403 Forbidden: scope missing (embeddings)` while generate sometimes returns 401 or 403. Very confusing for security review.

frida_infra: pulling auth logs now.

frida_infra: logs snippet: 
```
2025-04-02T14:10:11Z auth_check: key=sk.live.OLDKEY bound_project=acme-poc tenant=acme-org scopes=[generate,embeddings] decision=ALLOW
2025-04-02T14:10:43Z auth_check: key=sk.live.NEWKEY bound_project=acme-poc tenant=acme-org scopes=[generate] decision=ALLOW
2025-04-02T14:10:56Z auth_check: key=sk.live.NEWKEY bound_project=acme-demo tenant=acme-org scopes=[generate] decision=DENY (project mismatch)
```
Looks like: - OLDKEY still being presented by some runners (hence accepted for a short window), - NEWKEY was initially created with only [generate] scope (no embeddings), - one request had wrong project header (acme-demo) causing 403.

kevin_support: that explains it: 401s came from stale/rotated key propagation mismatch across edge cache; 403s from project header mismatch and missing scope for embeddings.

marco_acme: ah, our CD pipeline has a short-lived cache for secrets, some runners still had OLDKEY for ~2m after rotation. Do you invalidate cache on rotate? The questionnaire asks if keys are immediately revoked.

frida_infra: good question. We revoke keys immediately in the control plane but edge cache TTL was 2 minutes which allowed OLDKEY to be accepted briefly during propagation. We'll invalidate caches on rotate for this key and reduce TTL to 30s for presales tenants.

zoe_se: practical fixes for you: 1) re-run CI to pick up NEWKEY, 2) if you need embeddings, we can issue a new NEWKEY2 with scopes [generate,embeddings] bound to acme-poc, 3) ensure X-Redwood-Project header equals bound project (case-sensitive).

marco_acme: please issue NEWKEY2 with both scopes and rebind to acme-poc. Also we need a written blurb for the security questionnaire: Does Redwood immediately invalidate rotated keys? Where are logs for rotation events? Do you use KMS/HSM?

frida_infra: answering sec questions here (for records): - Keys are revoked immediately in control plane on rotation. Edge caches may accept an old key for up to 2m historically; we've reduced presales TTL to 30s and will invalidate caches on rotate going forward. - Audit logs: we log key create/rotate/rebind/revoke with actor, timestamp, and action id. We'll provide a link to the audit export for your tenant. - KMS: we integrate with customer KMS for Private deployments; hosted keys are stored encrypted using HSM-backed KMS (AWS KMS). We'll attach the standard security blurb and SOC/ISO references.

kevin_support: performed quick ops: 1) revoked OLDKEY at ts=1850000042 and invalidated edge cache for acme-org, 2) created NEWKEY2 (scopes: generate,embeddings) bound to acme-poc at ts=1850000060 action=act_rot_551, 3) reduced presales edge TTL for acme-org to 30s for future rotations.

ops_bot: Action recorded: act_rot_551 by frida_infra at 2025-04-02T14:14:20Z. OLDKEY revoked. NEWKEY2 issued. Edge cache invalidation triggered.

marco_acme: confirmed after re-run: generate and embeddings both return 200 with X-Redwood-Project: acme-poc. Thanks! Can you also confirm any link between this and the intermittent 429s we saw earlier during the load test?

frida_infra: unrelated: 429s were caused by hitting the trial throttle on that key (60rpm). For your demo we temporarily uplifted to 350rpm from 2025-04-02T14:00:00Z until 2025-04-02T18:00:00Z. We also recommend a Dedicated commit for stable 10 qps.

zoe_se: pricing ballpark for steady 10 qps on redwood-medium: estimated $7k-9k/month depending on token size and caching. For committed Dedicated capacity we can provide a formal quote via sales.

marco_acme: please send the audit log (action id) and the security blurb we can paste into our questionnaire.

frida_infra: attaching audit snippet to the ticket and will DM the security blurb & SOC references. Audit entries: act_rot_551 (NEWKEY2 created), act_revoke_550 (OLDKEY revoked).

dante_sales: I'll follow up with Marco on pricing and next steps for Dedicated. Thanks infra + SE for the fast turnaround. Closing this thread once Marco confirms receipt of audit doc. :thumbsup:
